author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the DMZ Worldbuilder trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the upcoming installment in the first-person action shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Every corner of DMZ has a story to tell. Explore the world, follow the clues, and uncover more about what happened here and what’s still waiting to be discovered. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Zombie Mode gameplay trailer for Red Light On, the hyper-realistic single-player first-person shooter developed by V Games. Players will embody a tactical officer investigating a case that goes awry. Fall back on combat tactics and utilize investigative abilities to seek the truth behind the case. Red Light On is coming soon to PC (Steam).

author: IGN
description:
Check out the first gameplay trailer for VCR83, a new surveillance psychological horror game where you observe and monitor strange happenings through security cameras, figuring out what happened during each shift in playable Aftermath sequences. Meanwhile, your friendly virtual assistant Pete becomes "increasingly involved" as the story progresses. Sounds a bit ominous... Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4668080/VCR83/
